I replied to Ilse in her #north-random thread to confirm the correction. The next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on 10 June, and that date replaces the one she posted in #north-team this morning.

She asked for no other action, so I didn't do anything else. I also didn't repeat or check the earlier #north-team post in #north-random, because people in this channel may not be able to see #north-team. A renewal date isn't a finance figure, so posting it here is fine.
